carla: Quick report from the onboarding sample: we saw duplicate side-effects when a 429 happened during token rotation + immediate retry. Short repro below.

carla: Repro: 1) start streaming POST /v1/chat, 2) token TTL expires, next chunk gets 429, 3) SDK refreshes token and immediately replays the same chunk, 4) server processed both -> duplicate.

sam: do we generate any stable operation id? sample currently uses per-chunk ids so retries look fresh.

carla: right now it's per-frame uuids. Also the SDK special-cases refresh path and does an immediate retry (no jitter).

ezra: two quick mitigations: (A) add a stable `X-RW-Operation-Id` header on stream start and include it in retried frames; (B) change refresh-path retry to full jitter: sleep = rand(0, base * 2**attempt) cap 10s. base ~200-250ms.

sam: server-side we can cheaply dedupe by op-id with a 60s cache and return 409 or set `X-RW-Dedupe-Result: duplicate` when seen. Document TTL and allow `Idempotency-Expiry` header for longer windows (server clamps).

carla: short-term patch for sampleapp: attach op id at start and reuse for chunk retries. snippet:
```
const opId = uuidv4();
fetch('/v1/streams/chat', { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'X-RW-Operation-Id': opId } });
// include opId in retried frames
```

ezra: parity note: make the SDK change across node/python/java: default opt-out `Idempotency-Key` for mutating calls, expose `setOperationId()` for streams, and ensure refresh-path uses full jitter.

devex-bot: opened RW-9001: "devex: refresh-path jitter + op-id + idempotency defaults" assigned to @sam.

sam: I'll open the sampleapp PR today and add a CI harness that forces token expiry mid-stream and asserts at-most-once processing. ezra can prototype SDK jitter change.

ezra: will push a small SDK patch with full-jitter and a config knob. Also adding a diagnostic opt-in response header `X-RW-Dedupe-Result` to help debug without server logs.

carla: action items checked: sam = sampleapp PR + test, ezra = SDK jitter + opt-in header, carla = onboarding doc update explaining op-id and expiry. Ping here with PR links. :mag:
